svg.title: Similarity Search
svg.desc: Three single beds act as references. Bed listings are closest; chair listings are furthest.
svg.metadata: Adapted from https://storage.googleapis.com/demo-dataset-quality-public/article/similarity_search.png. Original comparison layout retained. Product photos come from the original figure and https://dataset-quality.qdrant.tech/. The cropped pull-out daybed and pink bed are replaced with whole bed examples from the same demo. Product roles are unchanged; distances are illustrative, not measurements. Style: Qdrant shared figure tokens at dbf49e1e0f2a5e8369070adf895cc552c2f04814.

metal-bed: {"source": "https://dataset-quality.qdrant.tech:443/media/13993c48b94ae17fa5db6e42272c207f156546485f2ab8cbe1b4cb9a.jpeg", "crop": [0, 0, 632, 393], "pixels": [632, 393], "note": "Original product; demo annotation border removed. Top pair only where the source shows four."}

brown-chairs: {"source": "https://dataset-quality.qdrant.tech:443/media/dc3cff60ad8b179004d1982f6a273bcf0b0e8b2610ced73b1e4eb59d.jpeg", "crop": [16, 16, 1007, 782], "pixels": [640, 495], "note": "Original product; demo annotation border removed. Top pair only where the source shows four."}

Whole white daybed replaces the cropped pull-out daybed. Source: https://dataset-quality.qdrant.tech:443/media/2ae272d6d9ac5a74bb078ee2bfb9a7348c40590fb126eb1cc6dfe370.jpeg. Full source image retained, without cropping.

room-chair: {"source": "https://dataset-quality.qdrant.tech:443/media/6b1a11f359beb6b11dd264e2c847356eb98fb453c5794d88d403f1f9.jpeg", "crop": [16, 16, 1034, 1034], "pixels": [640, 640], "note": "Original product; demo annotation border removed. Top pair only where the source shows four."}

Whole light wood bed replaces the cropped pink bed. Source: https://dataset-quality.qdrant.tech:443/media/9f2224f68350c847bf09922eeef76e53b952505081611a781bbe4a2c.jpeg. Full source image retained, without cropping.
